text:
Priya: Heads-up from field: three enterprise customers asked for clearer upgrade/recovery SLAs for private deploys. they want commitments tied to install modes.
Sam: We should break scope into: 1) install-time networking guarantees (egress pinning, static IP preserve), 2) runtime handoff (relay/operator behavior), 3) upgrades (zero-downtime, rollback window).
Lena: Agreed. customers also push for a documented "minimal footprint" installer for air-gapped sites. little appetite for optional telemetry.
NetOps-Chris: From ops: priority is deterministic egress IP post-upgrade and a way to validate it automatically. recommend adding an e2e canary that posts an external IP and compares against expected.
Gabe: Implementation ideas: for operator lane we can use pre-upgrade snapshot + post-upgrade probe; for standalone add a hook in the offline installer to record egress config.
Priya: Proposed acceptance criteria per lane: operator: rolling minor upgrades with 95% success within 15m per node; standalone: documented manual steps + assisted rollback; relay: proxy shim that supports IP-preserve toggle and health checks.
Sam: Prioritization matrix suggestion: map customer revenue/urgency vs engineering effort. quick wins: relay shim and slim-installer. big bets: operator zero-downtime.
Lena: Customer asks to expose egress pinning toggle in console (simple checkbox) and a link to runbook that explains network diagnostics.
NetOps-Chris: Also want observability: handshake failure metric, egress-ip-change alert, per-customer egress-trace logs.
Gabe: Risks: some topologies (NAT with changing public IPs) may make preserve impossible. need clear "limitations" doc so field sets expectations.
Priya: Next steps: Sam map features to quarters (Q3 quick wins: relay shim, slim installer; Q4: operator zero-downtime work + canary infra). Gabe draft limitation doc. Lena draft console UI wire for egress toggle. NetOps-Chris design canary probe.
InfraBot: note: nightly-build 2025.4.1 will include bundle changes; use for slim-installer tests.
Priya: OK aiming to present to GTM Thurs; please drop deliverable estimations by EOD Wed.
